title: Final Velocity (Earth)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the velocity relative to Earth, v_r.

title: Final Time to Mars
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the time taken to reach Mars, t.

title: Final Velocity (Mars)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the velocity relative to Mars, v'_r.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate the application of energy conservation principles in deriving the velocities.

title: Kepler's Third Law
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply Kepler's third law to find the time taken to reach Mars.

title: Direction of Launch
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention the direction of launch relative to Earth's orbit.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student may make sign errors when calculating velocities relative to Earth and Mars.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student may neglect to include necessary gravitational factors in their calculations.
